description: This file is a shell script for testing the merging of notes trees in multiple git worktrees, including setup, conflicts, and merge operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution of commands.

calls: git notes add -m "x notes on tantrum" tantrum
git notes add -f -m "conflicting notes on tantrum" tantrum
git notes add -f -m "more conflicting notes on tantrum" tantrum
git worktree add -b newbranch worktree main
git worktree add -b newbranch2 worktree2 main
